intro.text: This patch increases the loot and frequency of Keeper Uprising mobs, and brings some improvements to the Region Queue system, loot distribution, player navigation, and the Armory. It also expands Dynamic Spawn Rates, and makes some important combat balance changes and bug fixes.

Note: With this patch, Vulkan support has been disabled for Android devices, as it could cause crashes while its performance benefits were unclear. We will continue to investigate these crashes in order to potentially re-enable it in the future.

blocks.text: The loot acquired through various features is a very common pain point for players. While we must keep an eye on the overall output of loot to safeguard the economy, many times we’ve seen that while the overall value was there, it was unfairly distributed amongst party members.
In order to reduce the frequency of poor loot draws, we’ve changed the loot distribution algorithm to attempt to fairly distribute loot across all participants.

To fairly preserve the contribution of each player’s Premium, chests will attempt to evenly split the value of their contents while still maintaining that Premium players receive ~50% more loot than non-Premium players. To achieve this, the Premium bonus applies to each player’s contribution to the overall Premium loot bonus, as this makes certain that Premium players still receive an average of 50% more without having to draw in loot from other players.

It’s important to note that while we hope this system will reduce the amount of bad loot experiences, it’s impossible to have a perfect split each time. High-value items, which still have a chance to go to any player regardless of Premium status, will almost always result in a large disparity of value. This system is also sub-optimal when large groups of players open chests intended for fewer players, as there’s generally not enough loot to ensure an even split.

Most importantly, this new distribution will not increase lucky draws – we have systems in place for this such as large objective chests, high-rarity chests, and the rare chance of high-value items. These distribution methods remain unchanged.
We’ll be monitoring this change as it goes live to make sure it lives up to our expectations, and we hope to bring you further loot improvements in the near future.

The Dynamic Spawn Rates introduced in the Paths to Glory update have been expanded to cover more features than before. The following features will now adjust their behavior depending on server activity:

items: Open-world dungeon mob/chest upgrade rates
Open-world dungeon event frequency
Respawn rates in open-world boss areas
Boss Lair Map spawn times
Wisp upgrade rates
Crystal Creature spawn times
Randomized Dungeon upgrade rates
Roads of Avalon chest upgrade rates
Dungeon spawn times in the Roads of Avalon

blocks.text: In addition, scaling is now slightly more aggressive in order to better balance earnings in peak hours and off hours.
